text: Ghost Tag is on! Run from the ghosts!
Here we go! Do not let the ghosts catch you!
The ghosts are waking up. Run!
New round! New ghosts!
Everyone back! The ghosts are in the crypt.
Get ready for the next round!
Ghosts, go and get them!
The ghosts are out! Run!
Here they come! Run, run, run!
Caught! Another ghost!
Boo! Got one!
Oh no, you are a ghost now!
Another one joins the ghosts!
Poof! Invisible!
Now you see them, now you do not!
Vanished!
A ghost lit its lantern!
The lantern can see invisible players!
Lantern on!
Ghost dash!
Whoosh! A ghost is speeding!
Watch out, a speedy ghost!
Garlic! The ghost bounced off!
Ha! The garlic shield worked!
Bounced! Garlic saves the day!
Frost bomb! The ghosts are frozen!
Brrr! Frozen ghosts!
Freeze! The ghosts cannot move!
Only two left!
Just two players left!
Two left! Who will win?
The last one standing wins the round!
We have a winner! The last one standing!
Last one standing! Amazing!
Time is up! Everyone still running wins the round!
That is the round! The survivors win!
Round over! Well done, survivors!
The ghosts caught everyone!
Everyone is a ghost! Spooky!
The ghosts win this round!
Ten seconds left in this round!
Hang on, nearly there!
Ten more seconds!
Power-ups! Run over one to grab it.
Teleports! Step in one to pop out of the other.
Sticky patches! They slow you down, but not the ghosts.
Fog! The big screen cannot see far. Use your device!
Watch out! Something swoops across the map and knocks you flying.
Join Class Live now!
Come and join in, everyone!
Grab your device and join the game!
Here we go! If we know this fact, what else do we know?
Star Web is on! How many facts can we find from this one?
Off we go! Use this fact to find lots more.
Here we go! Work along the chain and wake the serpent!
The serpent is sleeping. Work along the chain to wake it!
Off we go! Climb the serpent one sum at a time.
Here we go! Answer questions to flip the tiles!
A mystery picture is hiding. Answer questions to flip the tiles!
Off we go! Every right answer flips a tile.
An arm of the star web is lit!
Another arm lights up!
Look, a new arm is glowing!
Look! The sky creature is here!
Every arm is lit! Here comes the sky creature!
Wow! The sky creature has arrived!
Supernova! What a lot of facts!
Supernova! The whole sky is shining!
Boom! A supernova of facts!
The serpent is waking up!
Wake up, serpent! It is opening its eyes!
Rumble! The serpent is awake!
Someone reached the head of the serpent!
We made it to the head of the serpent!
All the way to the head! Brilliant!
Time's up! Now read the six riddles and pick the one that fits the picture.
Pens down! Which riddle fits the picture? Pick one on your device.
Time to guess! Read the riddles and choose the one that matches.
Everyone has picked! Let us see the picture!
All the guesses are in! Here comes the picture!
Everyone has chosen. Time for the big reveal!
Someone has guessed the picture!
A good guess! Someone got it!
We have a right guess!
Here's the picture!
Ta-da! Here it is!
Let's see the whole picture!
Time's up! Well done, everyone!
That's time! Great work, everyone!
Time's up! What a team!
Everyone reached the head! Amazing!
The whole class made it to the head!
All the way to the top, everyone! Brilliant!
Well done, everyone!
Great work, everyone!
What a team! Well done!
Here we go! When the countdown starts, run to a corner!
Four Corners is on! Pick a corner and run!
Off we go! Get to a corner before the dice rolls.
Run to a corner!
Go go go! Find a corner!
Quick, pick a corner!
Hurry, hurry! Nearly out of time!
Quick, the countdown is nearly over!
Get to a corner, now!
Here comes the dice!
Time to roll the dice!
The dice is rolling!
The red corner!
It is the red corner!
Red! The red corner!
The blue corner!
It is the blue corner!
Blue! The blue corner!
The green corner!
It is the green corner!
Green! The green corner!
The yellow corner!
It is the yellow corner!
Yellow! The yellow corner!
Two corners this time!
Twist! Two corners are out!
Oh no, two corners at once!
A lucky roll! Everyone in a corner is safe!
Lucky! Nobody is caught this time!
What luck! Every corner is safe!
Nobody was caught! Brilliant!
Everyone got away that time!
Not one pupil caught! Well done!
Oh no, lots of pupils off to jail!
Whoops! A big crowd is going to jail!
Clang! So many in jail this time!
A shield saved someone!
Phew! A shield kept someone safe!
Shield to the rescue!
Someone answered their way out of jail!
A great escape from jail!
Out of jail! Well done!
A power-up is switched on!
Power-up activated!
Someone switched on a power-up!
Here we go! Dance while the music plays. When it stops, sit on a throne!
Musical Thrones is on! When the music stops, find a throne!
Off we go! Listen for the music to stop, then grab a throne.
Stop! Sit down!
The music has stopped! Find a throne!
Freeze! Grab a throne, quick!
Stop the music! Sit, sit, sit!
One fewer throne this time!
Look, there are fewer thrones now!
The thrones are disappearing!
A golden throne! It is worth three crowns.
Look for the golden throne! Three crowns!
There is a golden throne this round!
Everyone found a throne!
Not one left standing! Brilliant!
A throne for everyone this time!
Oh no, lots of royals left standing!
So many standing! Off to the courtyard!
Whoops! A big crowd without a throne!
Anyone standing, off to the courtyard!
No throne? To the courtyard you go!
Those left standing go to the courtyard.
A throne has been stolen!
Sneaky! A crown thief struck!
Ooh, someone stole a throne!
Great dancing on the tiles! Bonus crowns!
Dance tile bonus!
Nice moves on the dance floor!
Someone answered their way back from the courtyard!
Back from the courtyard! Well done!
A royal return from the courtyard!
The music is back on! Dance!
Here comes the music again!
Dance time! Keep moving!
Power-ups have appeared in the castle hall! Grab one, then answer a question while the music plays to switch it on.
Watch out for the sticky honey! It slows you down.
Look, a magic mirror! Step in one end and you pop out of the other.
Careful, the polished floor! You will slide.
Look out for the rolling barrel! It knocks you flying.
Power-ups have appeared in the ice palace! Grab one, then answer a question while the music plays to switch it on.
Watch out for the blizzard! It slows you down.
Look, a ice portal! Step in one end and you pop out of the other.
Careful, the ice patch! You will slide.
Look out for the giant snowball! It knocks you flying.
Power-ups have appeared in the temple! Grab one, then answer a question while the music plays to switch it on.
Watch out for the mud pool! It slows you down.
Look, a vine swing! Step in one end and you pop out of the other.
Careful, the slippery leaves! You will slide.
Look out for the rolling boulder! It knocks you flying.
Power-ups have appeared on the deck! Grab one, then answer a question while the music plays to switch it on.
Watch out for the sea spray! It slows you down.
Look, a hatch! Step in one end and you pop out of the other.
Careful, the wet deck! You will slide.
Look out for the rolling cannonball! It knocks you flying.
Power-ups have appeared! Grab one, then answer a question in a corner to switch it on.
Watch out, a blizzard! It slows you down.
Look, ice portals! Step on one and you pop out of the other.
Careful, ice patches! You will slide.
Here comes the snow fog! You will not see everyone near the end.
Look out for the giant snowball! It will bump you aside.
Mind the cracked ice in the middle! Go round it.
The frozen gate will shut one corner just before the end!
Twist! Sometimes two corners are picked, and sometimes it is a lucky roll.
Power-ups are hiding in the jungle! Grab one, then answer a question in a corner to switch it on.
Watch out, a sandstorm! It slows you down.
Look, vine swings! Step on one and you pop out of the other.
Careful, mud slides! You will slide.
Here comes the jungle mist! You will not see everyone near the end.
Look out for the rolling boulder! It will bump you aside.
Mind the quicksand in the middle! Go round it.
The temple door will shut one corner just before the end!
Twist time! Sometimes two corners are picked, and sometimes it is a lucky roll.
Power-ups are floating around the castle! Grab one, then answer a question in a corner to switch it on.
Watch out, a ghost mist! It slows you down.
Look, magic mirrors! Step on one and you pop out of the other.
Careful, slippery moss! You will slide.
Here comes the spooky fog! You will not see everyone near the end.
Look out for the rolling barrel! It will bump you aside.
Mind the collapsed floor in the middle! Go round it.
The portcullis will shut one corner just before the end!
A twist! Sometimes two corners are picked, and sometimes it is a lucky roll.
Power-ups are drifting in space! Grab one, then answer a question in a corner to switch it on.
Watch out, a meteor storm! It slows you down.
Look, warp pads! Step on one and you pop out of the other.
Careful, zero-g zones! You will slide.
Here comes the nebula cloud! You will not see everyone near the end.
Look out for the rolling asteroid! It will bump you aside.
Mind the black hole in the middle! Go round it.
The airlock will shut one corner just before the end!
Twist alert! Sometimes two corners are picked, and sometimes it is a lucky roll.
Colour Clash is on! Run over the floor to paint it your colour!
Get ready to paint! Cover the floor in your team colour!
Here we go! Paint everything you can!
Fresh floor! Get ready to paint!
New round! Find an empty patch and paint it!
Get ready, painters!
Ten seconds left! Splat, splat, splat!
Ten seconds! Keep painting!
Nearly time! Ten seconds to go!
Time's up! Let's count the paint!
Brushes down! Who painted the most?
Stop! Let us see who covered the most floor!
It's a tie! What a battle!
Too close to call. It is a tie!
Exactly the same! A tie!
Red wins the round!
The red team takes it!
Red! Red painted the most!
Blue wins the round!
The blue team takes it!
Blue! Blue painted the most!
Green wins the round!
The green team takes it!
Green! Green painted the most!
Yellow wins the round!
The yellow team takes it!
Yellow! Yellow painted the most!
Power-ups have appeared! Run over one, then drop a paint bomb to switch it on.
Golden tiles! Each golden tile counts three. Paint them last!
Portals! Step into one and pop out of the other.
Watch out for the sticky patches. They slow you down!
Slippery paint! You will slide and you cannot stop fast.
Rollers are coming! Get hit and you go flying!
A fountain in the middle! Go round it. Nobody can paint it.
Here we go! Swim to a coloured quarter, or hide under a boat!
Shark Bay is on! Simon is hungry, so find a safe quarter!
Off we go! Keep off the jetty and watch out for Simon!
Swim, swim, swim! Find a quarter!
Quick, Simon is coming! Pick a colour!
Go go go! Hide under a boat or pick a colour!
Hide under a boat!
A boat is a safe place to hide!
Get under a boat, quick!
Hurry, hurry! Simon is nearly here!
Quick, the shark is almost here!
Get to a safe place, now!
Look out! A fin is circling the bay!
Simon is swimming round and round!
Here comes the fin!
The lights are going out! Where will Simon snap?
The spotlight is searching for Simon!
Dark water! Where is the shark going to snap?
Simon strikes Red!
Chomp! Simon bites the red quarter!
It is Red! Simon strikes Red!
Simon strikes Yellow!
Chomp! Simon bites the yellow quarter!
It is Yellow! Simon strikes Yellow!
Simon strikes Green!
Chomp! Simon bites the green quarter!
It is Green! Simon strikes Green!
Simon strikes Purple!
Chomp! Simon bites the purple quarter!
It is Purple! Simon strikes Purple!
Two sharks! Simon has a friend!
Oh no, two sharks this time!
Twist! Two quarters are struck!
Simon is full! Nobody is caught!
Simon has had enough! Everyone is safe!
Lucky! Simon is too full to bite!
The boats kept some pupils safe!
Phew! A boat saved some of you!
Safe under the boats!
Oh no, off to the shark cave!
Splash! A crowd is going to the shark cave!
Into the cave you go!
We know one times fact.
Use it to work out new facts. Turn it round, double, halve, times by ten, or add one more group.
Send your fact. Each new one becomes a star on the big screen.
Light up every arm of the web to bring out the sky creature!
Start at the stone. Do each sum along the serpent, one box at a time.
Write each answer on your device. You get two tries.
Every right answer moves your gem up the serpent.
Right answers from the whole class wake the serpent. Reach the head, then keep going on the bonus tail!
Today it is the sprout serpent: adding and taking away small numbers.
Today it is the leaf serpent: adding and taking away, numbers up to one hundred.
Today it is the green serpent: adding and taking away.
Today it is the jade serpent: adding and taking away, with times and share by two and ten.
Today it is the gold serpent: all four, with times and share by two, five and ten.
Today it is the amber serpent: all four, with times and share by two, three, four, five and ten.
Today it is the ruby serpent: all four, with times tables up to six, and numbers up to one thousand.
Today it is the fire serpent: all four, with times tables up to twelve.
A mystery picture is hiding under the tiles.
Answer maths questions on your device. Each right answer flips a tile, and you can see your tiles on your device.
Keep answering until the time is up. The more tiles we flip, the more of the picture we see.
Then read the six riddles and pick the one that fits the picture!
Move your avatar with the joystick, or the arrow keys.
Get to a corner before the countdown ends!
Then the dice picks a corner. Anyone in that corner, or in no corner, goes to jail.
In jail, answer three questions to come back.
Grab power-ups on the map, then answer a question in a corner to switch them on. The most safe rounds wins!
Swim your avatar with the joystick, or the arrow keys.
The bay has four coloured quarters, and they slowly spin round!
Get to a quarter before the countdown ends. Do not stay on the jetty!
Simon the shark strikes a quarter. Anyone in it, or on the jetty, goes to the shark cave.
Hide under a boat and you are safe, but boats only have a few seats! In the cave, answer three questions to swim back out.
Steer your avatar with the joystick, or the arrow keys.
A few players start as ghosts. If a ghost touches you, you become a ghost too.
Answer a question right to turn invisible for five seconds. Ghosts cannot catch you then!
Ghosts answer questions too, for a speed dash or a lantern that finds invisible players.
The last one standing wins the round. Win the most rounds to win the game!
You are on a colour team. Move your avatar with the joystick, or the arrow keys.
Every tile you run over turns your team colour.
Tap the bomb and answer a question. Get it right to splat your colour all around you! You stand still while you answer.
Get answers right in a row for a bigger splat.
When the time is up we count the paint. The team that wins the most rounds wins!
Move your royal avatar with the joystick, or the arrow keys.
While the music plays, dance about. Stand on a glowing dance tile when it stops for a bonus crown.
When the music stops, run and sit on a throne! There are fewer thrones every round.
If you are left standing, go to the courtyard and answer three questions to come back. Three right in a row wins a crown thief scroll!
A throne is one crown, a golden throne is three. The most crowns wins!
Here we go! The floor is lava! Watch for the glowing tiles!
Floor is Lava is on! Stay off the glowing tiles!
Off we go! When a tile glows, get off it!
Find a safe tile!
Off the glowing tiles, quick!
Move, move! Find solid rock!
Three seconds! Get off the glow!
Hurry! The floor is about to crack!
Quick, the tiles are going to break!
Crack! There goes the floor!
Rumble, crack, splash!
Down they go into the lava!
Everyone is safe! Brilliant footwork!
Nobody fell in! Amazing!
Not one splash! Well done!
Splash! Lots of you are on the lava raft!
Oh no! A big splash into the lava!
So many on the raft! Answer to climb back!
Fire boots saved someone!
Those fire boots work! Safe on the lava!
Lava walker! Fire boots to the rescue!
Back on the floor!
Someone climbed off the raft!
Welcome back to the floor!
A new bridge!
Somebody built a bridge!
Brick by brick!
What a rescue!
Saved from the raft by a friend!
A kind rescue!
Watch out! More tiles are glowing!
Aftershock! New tiles are glowing!
Look! The glow is spreading!
Glowing patches! Find the solid rock!
Stripes! Every other line is going to crack!
A checkerboard! Jump to the right squares!
Rings! A whole ring of the floor is glowing!
A giant cross is glowing! Get out of the middle lines!
Islands! Only a few small islands will stay up!
A wave of glow is sweeping across! Get out of its way!
Power-ups have appeared! Grab one, then answer a question to switch it on.
Bubbles! They slow you down, so go round them.
Slippery patches! You slide when you step on them.
A rolling fireball! It will knock you flying, maybe into the lava!
Watch out! Now some tiles start glowing late, near the end of the countdown.
Run round the floor with the joystick, or the arrow keys.
When tiles glow, get off them! When the countdown ends, they crack and sink into the lava.
Fall in, and you go on the lava raft. Wait for a friend to rescue you, or answer five questions to climb back.
Answer questions to earn bricks. Use a brick to build a bridge over the lava, or two bricks to rescue a friend.
Grab power-ups, then answer a question to switch them on. Stay up the most rounds to win!
Today we are on Volcano Island.
Today we are in the Dragon's Lair.
Today we are in the Lava Forge.
Today we are on the Lava Planet.
